transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Thanks both. Hannah, what would make this an easy yes for Owen?

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Owen will want to see the handle-time savings from the Austin pilot. If we can show a 15 percent drop in average handle time, the business case makes itself.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: For context, the Dublin agents work all of our EU customer tickets, so they're the bigger change.

transcript.speaker: speaker_04
transcript.text: We can mirror the Austin routing rules for Dublin and keep separate queues per region.

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Good. We'd like to be live before the December ticket surge.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: I'll send a business case with the Austin pilot numbers by Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Great - I'll take it to Owen myself.
